summary: Quantum X Inc., formerly Two Hands Corporation, filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026 reporting that FINRA completed its review of the company's name change and announced a trading symbol change from TWOH to QUTX on its Daily List on September 11, 2026. Both the name change and symbol change became effective in the over-the-counter market at the open on September 14, 2026. The company states the changes do not affect stockholder rights, outstanding certificates bearing the former name remain valid, and no stockholder action is required. This is a routine corporate administrative event, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed.
